criteria.description: Maps all named data flow categories; explicitly catches raw phone/booking identifiers in analytics and over-disclosure to messaging vendor.
Addresses support CSV export, retention/deletion, propagation, backups, and unknown policy without fictitious deadlines.
Treats jurisdiction, legal basis and compliance claims as unverified decisions needing qualified review.
Includes concrete security/vendor access restrictions and actionable negative acceptance tests.
Provides a prioritized risk register or explicit block/release disposition tied to verification evidence.
